title: Will an obscure single-supplier materials contract be renewed before year end?
description: Thinly-traded conditional market with a shallow LMSR book. Liquidity is far below the charter floor, so any meaningful position would move the price drastically (high slippage) and a fill would be unreliable. The market nominally references a materials hedge but is illiquid and the only viable position size blows past the risk budget.

hedge.note: Illiquid + would require an oversized position to hedge; expect escalation.
